projects.title: Indoor localization with WiFi triangulation
projects.summary: Estimating indoor positions from WiFi signals where GPS falls short.
projects.detail: Developed RSSI-based distance estimation and triangulation using multiple access points. Built a signal-processing pipeline, collected data, modeled signals, handled noise, and evaluated performance in real indoor settings.

projects.title: AI-powered research assistant
projects.summary: A full-stack RAG assistant for summaries, citations, and paper comparisons.
projects.detail: Built Flask and Gradio interfaces with RAG pipelines and OpenAI LLM APIs. Improved summary relevance by 38% through prompt engineering, modular pipelines, and HCI-driven usability feedback. Integrated BibTeX parsing, ranking, and interactive comparison across 100+ papers.

projects.title: Sorting dice with robotic arm control
projects.summary: Real-time perception and motion planning for autonomous dice sorting.
projects.detail: Deployed ROS and MoveIt with a UR5 manipulator. Calibrated joint-space and camera transforms, reaching 91.3% classification precision under variable lighting. Integrated depth sensing, YOLOv8, and motion planning with latency below 200 ms per action cycle.
